title: Four domains in sequence: training loss for three conditions
caption: Three conditions trained on the same four-domain stream. All three learn each domain in turn; the difference between them shows up afterwards, in what they keep.
alt: Line chart of training loss over one pass through four domains (US government documents, Yoruba, Amharic, news) for three conditions: Learner 1.0 (1x), Learner 1.0 (2x), LoRA r256.
smoothing: exponential moving average, span 31 steps (lines); none (pale band: raw minimum to maximum for the 1x condition)
transforms: x axis is the step within the four-domain stream, starting at 1
